goal: Implement the core Space Invaders game engine within app/page.tsx using an HTML5 canvas. Develop a complete game loop handling player movement, enemy grid synchronization, projectile firing, collision detection, score tracking, and game over conditions.

steps.instruction: Create `src/app/page.tsx` as a route-bound Space Invaders game engine with a canvas render loop, keyboard input, synchronized enemy grid, projectile firing, collision detection, score tracking, lives, and game-over state.
